bessel_i_scaled	higher	Special functions	bessel_i_scaled(nu, x): e^-x I_nu(x), without overflow at large x
det	higher	Linear algebra	det(m): the determinant of a square matrix (exact, symbolic, ball or machine)
inverse	higher	Linear algebra	inverse(m): the inverse of a square matrix; failure(singular, inverse) when it has none
pseudo_inverse	higher	Linear algebra	pseudo_inverse(m): the Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse of a matrix of numbers
rank	higher	Linear algebra	rank(m): the rank of a matrix (machine matrices by singular values above max(r, c) eps s_max)
null_space	higher	Linear algebra	null_space(m): a basis of the vectors x with dot(m, x) == 0 (orthonormal for machine matrices)
row_reduce	higher	Linear algebra	row_reduce(m): the reduced row echelon form
linear_solve	higher	Linear algebra	linear_solve(m, b): a solution x of dot(m, x) == b for a vector or matrix b; failure(no_solution, linear_solve) when inconsistent
eigenvalues	higher	Linear algebra	eigenvalues(m): the eigenvalues with multiplicity, by decreasing modulus (exact through the factored characteristic polynomial)
eigenvectors	higher	Linear algebra	eigenvectors(m): one eigenvector per eigenvalue in the order of eigenvalues(m); zero vectors for a defective eigenvalue
eigensystem	higher	Linear algebra	eigensystem(m): [eigenvalues(m), eigenvectors(m)]
characteristic_polynomial	higher	Linear algebra	characteristic_polynomial(m, x): det(x I - m), monic in x
identity_matrix	higher	Linear algebra	identity_matrix(n): the n x n identity matrix
diagonal_matrix	higher	Linear algebra	diagonal_matrix(v), diagonal_matrix(v, k): the square matrix with v on the k-th diagonal and zeros elsewhere
dot	higher	Linear algebra	dot(a, b, ...): the product of vectors and matrices (scalar product, matrix-vector, matrix-matrix), from the left
cross	higher	Linear algebra	cross(u, v): the cross product of two vectors of length 3
kronecker_product	higher	Linear algebra	kronecker_product(a, b, ...): the Kronecker product of matrices (or of vectors)
trace	higher	Linear algebra	trace(m): the sum of the diagonal of a square matrix
norm	higher	Linear algebra	norm(v), norm(v, p), norm(m), norm(m, 1 | inf | "frobenius"): vector p-norms (p a positive integer or inf) and matrix norms (default the 2-norm)
lu	higher	Linear algebra	lu(m): [l, u, p] with l unit lower triangular, u upper triangular and m[p] == dot(l, u)
qr	higher	Linear algebra	qr(m): [q, r] with m == dot(q, r), q with orthonormal columns, r upper triangular
cholesky	higher	Linear algebra	cholesky(m): the upper triangular u with m == dot(conjugate_transpose(u), u) for a positive definite m
svd	higher	Linear algebra	svd(m): [u, s, v] with m == dot(u, s, conjugate_transpose(v)), s diagonal with decreasing singular values (machine matrices)
singular_values	higher	Linear algebra	singular_values(m): the nonzero singular values in decreasing order
grad	higher	Linear algebra	grad(f, [x1, ..., xn]): the gradient [d(f, x1), ...]; for a list of functions the Jacobian matrix
div	higher	Linear algebra	div(v, [x1, ..., xn]): the divergence d(v1, x1) + ... + d(vn, xn)
curl	higher	Linear algebra	curl(v, [x, y, z]): the curl of a vector field; curl([v1, v2], [x, y]) the scalar curl
laplacian	higher	Linear algebra	laplacian(f, [x1, ..., xn]): the sum of the second derivatives d(d(f, xi), xi)
matrix_function	higher	Linear algebra	matrix_function(f, m): the matrix function f(m) (diagonal, triangular, eigenvector or interpolation forms)
matrix_exp	higher	Linear algebra	matrix_exp(m): the matrix exponential; matrix_exp(m, v) its product with v
matrix_log	higher	Linear algebra	matrix_log(m): the principal matrix logarithm
matrix_power	higher	Linear algebra	matrix_power(m, k): the k-th matrix power (integer k by repeated squaring, negative k through the inverse)
conjugate_transpose	higher	Linear algebra	conjugate_transpose(m): the conjugate of the transpose of m
hilbert_matrix	higher	Linear algebra	hilbert_matrix(n): the n x n Hilbert matrix 1/(i + j - 1); hilbert_matrix([m, n]) rectangular
rotation_matrix	higher	Linear algebra	rotation_matrix(theta): the 2D rotation by theta; rotation_matrix(theta, w): the 3D rotation about the axis w
sparse_array	higher	Linear algebra	sparse_array(rules, dims, default): the array with the values of position -> value rules (literal or pattern positions), built dense; sparse_array(automatic, dims, default, data): the compressed row form
region	higher	Regions	region(r): the region r shown as a region (it stays as it is; the region functions read through it)
implicit_region	higher	Regions	implicit_region(cond, [x, y, ...]): the points whose coordinates satisfy cond, e.g. implicit_region(x^2 + y^2 <= 1, [x, y])
parametric_region	higher	Regions	parametric_region([f1, f2, ...], [[u, a, b], ...]): the points (f1, f2, ...) for the parameters in their ranges
simplex	higher	Regions	simplex([p1, ..., pk]): the convex hull of k affinely independent points; simplex(n): the standard simplex of n dimensions
tetrahedron	higher	Regions	tetrahedron([p1, p2, p3, p4]): the solid tetrahedron with these corners; tetrahedron(): the standard one
empty_region	higher	Regions	empty_region(n): the empty region of n dimensions (the result of an empty intersection)
region_member	higher	Regions	region_member(reg, p): whether the point p lies in the region (true or false; a condition for a symbolic point); region_member(reg, [p1, p2, ...]) for several
region_measure	higher	Regions	region_measure(reg): the measure of the region in its own dimension: length of a curve, area of a surface, volume of a solid (0 for points)
area	higher	Regions	area(reg): the area of a two-dimensional region
volume	higher	Regions	volume(reg): the volume of a three-dimensional region
arc_length	higher	Regions	arc_length(reg): the length of a one-dimensional region
region_centroid	higher	Regions	region_centroid(reg): the centroid (centre of mass of uniform density) of the region
region_bounds	higher	Regions	region_bounds(reg): the ranges [[xmin, xmax], [ymin, ymax], ...] of the region's coordinates (numerical for implicit and parametric regions)
region_dimension	higher	Regions	region_dimension(reg): the region's own dimension (0 points, 1 curves, 2 surfaces, 3 solids)
region_embedding_dimension	higher	Regions	region_embedding_dimension(reg): the number of coordinates of the region's points
is_bounded_region	higher	Regions	is_bounded_region(reg): whether the region lies inside a ball of finite radius
region_distance	higher	Regions	region_distance(reg, p): the distance from the point p to the region (0 inside)
signed_region_distance	higher	Regions	signed_region_distance(reg, p): the distance from p to the region's boundary, negative inside a solid region
region_nearest	higher	Regions	region_nearest(reg, p): the point of the region nearest to p
region_union	higher	Regions	region_union(r1, r2, ...): the union of plane polygons (rectangles, triangles, disks as fine polygons) as a polygon
region_intersection	higher	Regions	region_intersection(r1, r2, ...): the intersection of plane polygons as a polygon (empty_region(2) when empty)
region_difference	higher	Regions	region_difference(r1, r2): the part of the plane polygon r1 outside r2, as a polygon (with holes where r2 lies inside r1)
region_integrate	higher	Regions	region_integrate(f, [x, y, ...], reg): the integral of f over the region, as iterated integrals of its parametrisation (also region_integrate(f, element([x, y], reg)))
